column3: Close to the Greek; “authority” is rendered “power.”
Close to the Greek; “two assaria” is rendered “two copper coins.”
NKJV has “bring you to,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “bring you in before.”
NKJV has “covetousness,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “all covetousness.”
NKJV has “all my crops,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “all the grain.”
NKJV has “your life,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “the life.”
NKJV has “one cubit to his stature”; the Greek may refer to length of life rather than height.
